rows.text: The effects depend on the substance: some cause drowsiness, others excitement; both can impair driving.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/summer-driving-tips — droghe possono compromettere coordinazione, giudizio, percezione e reazioni
https://www.nhtsa.gov/book/countermeasures-that-work/drug-impaired-driving/understanding-problem — cannabis: percezione distorta, coordinazione compromessa e possibili deficit di attenzione divisa

rows.text: A substance can slow reactions and impair coordination, making the vehicle harder to control.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/summer-driving-tips — droghe possono compromettere coordinazione, giudizio, percezione e reazioni
https://www.nhtsa.gov/book/countermeasures-that-work/drug-impaired-driving/understanding-problem — cannabis: percezione distorta, coordinazione compromessa e possibili deficit di attenzione divisa

https://www.nhtsa.gov/book/countermeasures-that-work/drug-impaired-driving/understanding-problem — cannabis: percezione distorta, coordinazione compromessa e possibili deficit di attenzione divisa

https://www.nhtsa.gov/book/countermeasures-that-work/drug-impaired-driving/understanding-problem — cannabis: percezione distorta, coordinazione compromessa e possibili deficit di attenzione divisa

rows.text: Drugs can impair attention and judgment, making danger harder for the driver to recognize.

rows.text: Sleeping pills can cause drowsiness and impair attention and judgment, even when the driver does not realize the risk.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/drug-impaired-driving/dangers-driving-after-taking-prescription-drugs-or-over-counter-medicines — sonniferi possono provocare sonnolenza e alterare giudizio; https://www.nhtsa.gov/book/countermeasures-that-work/drug-impaired-driving/understanding-problem — depressori causano sonnolenza e difficoltà di concentrazione

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE. Caffeine in energy drinks can temporarily increase alertness, but effects depend on the amount and the person: it can disturb sleep and does not replace rest. Do not drive when sleepy.
evidence: Supplied official AM PDF page 152 prints FALSO; adjacent 27381–27383 refer to alcohol abuse, drugs and sleeping pills. The ordinary-use contrast is editorial interpretation, not a documented official rationale.
EFSA https://www.efsa.europa.eu/en/topics/topic/caffeine : caffeine increases alertness and may disturb sleep; effects vary with dose and individual sensitivity.
NHTSA https://www.nhtsa.gov/risky-driving/drowsy-driving : coffee or energy drinks alone do not replace adequate sleep and sleep-deprived drivers can remain impaired.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE. In ordinary culinary use, spices differ from the intoxicating substances discussed in the nearby questions. This does not apply to excessive doses: large amounts of nutmeg, for example, can cause severe drowsiness.
evidence: Supplied official AM PDF page 152 prints FALSO. Ordinary culinary use is a qualified editorial interpretation; the question itself gives no dose and its official rationale is unknown.
National Capital Poison Center https://www.poison.org/articles/kitchen-surprises-and-cautions : use recommended recipe quantities; large amounts of nutmeg can cause severe drowsiness and poisoning.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE. An ordinary non-alcoholic fizzy drink differs from an alcoholic drink: carbonation itself does not cause alcohol intoxication. Drinks can have different ingredients and effects; drinking while driving can distract you.
evidence: Supplied official AM PDF page 152 prints FALSO. Ordinary nonalcoholic use is an editorial interpretation, not a verified official rationale or a claim of universal safety for every composition.

De Longis et al. 2022 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9183000/ : small randomized study investigated carbonation and caffeine effects on attention; it does not establish universal safety of carbonated drinks.
NHTSA https://www.nhtsa.gov/risky-driving/distracted-driving : eating or drinking while driving is a distraction.

rows.text: The prohibition also protects road structures and installations: damaging them can endanger traffic.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-15.php — Codice della strada art. 15 comma 1 lettere a, f, i vieta danneggiamento, deposito rifiuti e lancio da veicoli

rows.text: Nothing may be thrown from a moving vehicle: it can dirty the road or create a hazard.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-15.php — Codice della strada art. 15 comma 1 lettere a, f, i vieta danneggiamento, deposito rifiuti e lancio da veicoli

rows.text: It is forbidden to deposit waste on the road or its associated areas, which must remain clear and clean.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-15.php — Codice della strada art. 15 comma 1 lettere a, f, i vieta danneggiamento, deposito rifiuti e lancio da veicoli

rows.text: Giving way to pedestrians is not forbidden: for example, at an uncontrolled crossing drivers must slow down and stop for people crossing or immediately nearby.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-191.php — Codice della strada art. 191 comma 1 precedenza ai pedoni sugli attraversamenti

rows.text: The horn is not forbidden everywhere: use it sparingly for safety; in built-up areas it is allowed in actual and immediate danger.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-156.php — Codice della strada art. 156 commi 1-3 uso moderato per sicurezza e pericolo immediato nei centri abitati

rows.text: There is no general prohibition: mopeds must use lights even during the day; daytime running lights may replace dipped headlights where permitted.
evidence: https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-152.php — Codice della strada art. 152 comma 1 luci di giorno e alternativa luci di marcia diurna

rows.text: A steady speed, when conditions permit, avoids unnecessary acceleration and braking that increase fuel consumption.
evidence: https://afdc.energy.gov/files/u/publication/gas-saving_tips.pdf — guida regolare, accelerazioni, velocità, manutenzione e soste influenzano consumo

rows.text: Frequent or harsh acceleration uses more fuel; smooth driving helps reduce consumption.
evidence: https://afdc.energy.gov/files/u/publication/gas-saving_tips.pdf — guida regolare, accelerazioni, velocità, manutenzione e soste influenzano consumo

rows.text: Maintenance according to the manufacturer’s instructions helps limit waste: for example, repairing an out-of-tune engine can reduce fuel consumption, with results varying by repair.
evidence: https://afdc.energy.gov/files/u/publication/gas-saving_tips.pdf p. 2, Keep Your Car in Shape — riparare un motore sensibilmente fuori regolazione può migliorare il consumo; il risultato dipende dalla riparazione

rows.text: High speed is not a way to save fuel: air resistance increases with speed and fuel consumption can rise.
evidence: https://afdc.energy.gov/files/u/publication/gas-saving_tips.pdf — guida regolare, accelerazioni, velocità, manutenzione e soste influenzano consumo
https://www.energy.gov/sites/prod/files/2015/07/f24/vss006_salari_2015_o.pdf p. 10 — aerodynamic drag increases with the square of air speed

rows.text: There is no need to avoid level roads: climbing requires extra energy, and the fuel saved downhill does not always offset the fuel used uphill.
evidence: https://nepis.epa.gov/Exe/ZyPURL.cgi?Dockey=9100MVY2.TXT p. 9, Road Condition — per le automobili i percorsi collinari consumano più di quelli pianeggianti, perché il risparmio in discesa non compensa la salita; principio energetico applicato al ciclomotore

rows.text: During a prolonged stop, a running engine consumes fuel without moving; switching it off avoids this waste.
evidence: https://afdc.energy.gov/files/u/publication/gas-saving_tips.pdf — guida regolare, accelerazioni, velocità, manutenzione e soste influenzano consumo

rows.text: Keeping the fuel system in good condition helps limit emissions: for example, on a carbureted moped, correct carburetor adjustment forms part of exhaust emissions control.
evidence: https://cdn.powersports.honda.com/documentum/MWOM/ml.remawmom.2022_ruckus__nps50__owner_s_manual.pdf p. 84, Exhaust Emission Control System — sullo scooter 50 cc il controllo delle emissioni comprende la corretta regolazione del carburatore
https://nepis.epa.gov/Exe/ZyPURL.cgi?Dockey=P100231W.TXT sezioni 3.1.3.1 e 3.2 — il controllo del rapporto aria-carburante e della combustione influenza le emissioni dei motocicli

checked_sources: https://www.nhtsa.gov/risky-driving/drowsy-driving — la caffeina può dare vigilanza temporanea ma non elimina la compromissione dovuta a sonno insufficiente; non prova la causalità attribuita alla bevanda
https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s41782-017-0019-4 — studio sperimentale sulla guida prolungata e bevanda energetica, non prova che ogni bevanda non possa causare disattenzione

issues.reason: Il quesito non precisa spezia, dose o modalità d’uso; l’uso alimentare ordinario non equivale a un’ingestione eccessiva. Non è verificato un fondamento per escludere la possibilità formulata in termini generali.
checked_sources: https://www.fda.gov/media/171758/download — la tossicità della miristicina è poco probabile alle normali concentrazioni alimentari, ma dosi elevate di noce moscata hanno causato sintomi simili a intossicazione alcolica

https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK557004/pdf/Bookshelf_NBK557004.pdf — riporta alterazioni percettive e visione offuscata da sovradosaggio di noce moscata; non determina il significato inteso dal quesito

issues.reason: Il quesito non specifica la composizione della bevanda analcolica molto gasata. Non è stata trovata una fonte che dimostri che tutte queste bevande non possano causare gli effetti indicati, né che attribuisca il verdetto alla sola anidride carbonica.
checked_sources: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9183000/ — studio sperimentale sugli effetti di carbonazione e caffeina sull’attenzione, non una dimostrazione generale per tutte le bevande molto gasate
https://www.nhtsa.gov/summer-driving-tips — alcol e droghe possono compromettere capacità di guida; non stabilisce gli effetti di tutte le bevande analcoliche gasate

Printed FALSO is not explained: temporary alertness and residual fatigue do not establish why energy drinks are not the cause alleged in the question. NHTSA warns sleep-deprived drivers may remain impaired after caffeine; it does not establish that energy drinks cannot cause inattention. Preserve the printed verdict and seek authoritative support or adjudication rather than treating this as a generic tiredness question.

The explanations merely state that ordinary spices or carbonation are not the cause identified by the quiz, then list unrelated impairing substances; they do not explain the causal distinction. The cited false quiz assertions cannot establish the negative factual claims, and the NHTSA references do not address spices or carbonation. Provide directly supporting evidence and an actual explanation, preserving the printed verdict.

This is evidence about possible product composition, not an Italian labelling rule. Avoid a categorical zero-alcohol assertion; preserve the printed FALSO, individual/composition qualification, and avoid claiming all such beverages are harmless or asserting an unverified official rationale.
